summary.text: Eric Turer is the incumbent Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists his tenure in the House as beginning in 2022, and he is a consultant.

paragraphs.text: Turer was born in the Bronx, New York, and as of 2023 lives in Brentwood, New Hampshire.
He earned a high school diploma from New Rochelle High School and an M.B.A. in health systems administration from Union College in 1989.
His career experience includes working in health care systems and as a policy consultant.
